candidates.description: This vector represents German and English words and suffixes related to academic degrees, levels, and the verb "to graduate" or its German equivalents ("ieren").
These tokens represent German modal and auxiliary verbs indicating necessity, possibility, or permission.
This vector represents medical professionals, titles, and related healthcare terminology.
This vector represents academic, scientific, and systematic investigation and educational activities.
This feature vector represents prominent universities and higher education institutions.
This feature vector represents German verb conjugations and noun forms related to the root word "Grad" or the suffix "-iert".
This vector represents common professional titles and abbreviations starting with the letters "pro" or "priv".
This feature vector activates strongly on proper nouns and roots associated with historical, literary, and geographical names, as well as capitalized words across multiple European languages.
This vector activates on German prepositional and lexical roots, particularly those starting with "Für" or "för".
This vector represents German adverbial and conjunctive connectors used to link clauses or modulate statements.
